name: Cyber Eye
description: An eye implant: +1 to aimed shots and low-light vision. Rejection +1. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Targeting Link
description: A military targeting link: +1 Firearms. Rejection +2. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Subdermal Armor
description: Woven armor under the skin: +1 armor, obvious to scanners. Rejection +2. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Prosthetic Arm
description: A powered prosthetic: +1 Grit for feats of strength. Rejection +1. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Prosthetic Leg
description: A powered leg: +1 Athletics and no penalty from a ruined leg. Rejection +1. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Neural Jack
description: A skull port: +1 Computer Use and a direct interface with machines. Rejection +2. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Adrenal Pump
description: An implant that once per scene adds +1 to a physical roll, and is addictive. Rejection +2. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Data Port
description: A visible data port: store and read drives, +1 to recall. Rejection +1. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Built-in Tool
description: A folding tool in the forearm: a tool without hands. Rejection +1. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.

name: Black-Market Heart
description: A replacement heart that ignores one dying result. Rare and dangerous. Rejection +3. Needs power or maintenance; a dead implant is inert.
